title: operation-progress (WUI-21 server-side contract)
description:
One read-model record for the progress of a single operation, as the Observer may render it.

Every enum member is traceable to a producer, and the states the owner's pack names but this repository
cannot yet answer are carried as declared gaps instead of being dropped or invented: `SUBMITTING` (the
client-to-ledger handoff is recorded nowhere) has no state value, and a lost or unreadable answer becomes
`UNKNOWN`, never a default. Timeout is its own state: `UNKNOWN_OR_TIMEOUT` — a lease that expired says the
observation stopped being trustworthy, which is not the same claim as `FAILED`.

task_id.description: The operation identity. It is never replaced by a display name and never guessed from a similar one.

observed_at.description: When this record was built. A record whose transport is offline keeps reporting the time it was read, not the time the state last held.

state.description: The pack's five named stages plus every state the ledger really has. PASSED comes from COMPLETED and nothing else: a submitted plan is not a passed operation. There is deliberately no SUBMITTING member — no producer answers it, so it appears in producer_gaps instead.

ledger_status.description: The Task Ledger's own spelling, kept beside the mapped state so a reader can see the mapping rather than trust it. null when the ledger did not answer.

last_trusted_progress.description: The last progress this repository can stand behind. It survives a dropped connection: the current state may go UNKNOWN while this stays, and the two are never merged.

basis.description: Which observation the trusted value rests on. NONE means there is no trusted progress to show, and is not the same as an empty timestamp.

transport_state.description: Transport as the snapshot names it (ONLINE / DELAYED / OFFLINE / …), or null when nothing observed it. Copying it here lets the page explain that a stale answer is stale, without deciding what the operation is doing.

producer_gaps.description: Fields the pack asks for that no producer in this repository answers. The list is part of the contract so the UI renders a named gap rather than a zero or a spinner forever.

target_behaviour.description: Separate result #3. Carried only when the ledger holds an external-effect record for this task (EXTERNAL_EFFECT_STATES in packages/client-neutral-core/scripts/task_ledger.py:21); null means nothing was reconciled, which is not a failure and not a pass.
